    {α : Type*}

name: Rank3KUM.HalfWeave.woven_successor_adjacency
statement:
theorem woven_successor_adjacency
    {α : Type*}
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)
    (y : Fin (2 * k) ≃ α)
    (p : Fin k × Bool) :
    (∃ i : Fin k,
        p = (i, false) ∧
        (woven k hk y p,
         woven k hk y (weaveNext k hk p)) =
        (y (firstIndex k i),
         y (secondIndex k i))) ∨
    (∃ i : Fin k,
        p = (i, true) ∧
        (woven k hk y p,
         woven k hk y (weaveNext k hk p)) =
        (y (secondIndex k i),
         y (firstIndex k (cyclicSucc k hk i))))

     woven k hk y

    (y (secondIndex k (lastFin k hk)),
